tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dbang bskur ba'i tho yig bzhugs so// dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba'i tho yig dbang gi chu bo rgyas byed ces bya ba/ rab rgyas mkhyen brtse'i rin chen yid bzhin dbang / /rab rgyas bkra shis grags pa'i gzi 'bar ba/ /rab rgyas bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/ /rab rgyas chos char 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de gsung nges pa'i bdud rtsi ro brgya pa/ /bde chen ye shes rgyas byed rgyun bzang 'di/ /srid mthar spel ba'i bsam sbyor bzang po yis/ /nyung gsal go bde'i lag len bri bar bya/ /'dir ras bris la brten pa'i phyogs la/ gang du bya ba'i phyogs der dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par bsham/ sngon du 'gro ba gtor ma/ sgrub thabs su bstan pa ltar bsangs sbyangs nas/ mū kha hūm̐ hūm̐ gis mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ nag phyogs bskrad pa'i bar bya/ gnas dang mchod pa byin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste/ rang he ru kar bsdu ba'i bar/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin byas la/ slar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ sa lha'i tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ baṃ las sa'i lha mo dga' ba dang bcas pa'i thugs ka na/ gser mo rgyan gyis mdzes pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ rang gi lag mthil g.yas par zla ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ so sor dbus ma gsum pa la lan gsum bsnun zhing / hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭak+ki hūm̐ phaṭa e haṃ/ zhes pa'i sgras bskul te sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ spyan drangs dbang bskur/ rnam snang gi dbu brgyan pa/ chu bzhi nyer spyod bdud rtsi dbul/ a kā ros gtor ma dbul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad dang / sogs kyi mkhyen par bsam mo/ /sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ zhes brjod/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyis thun mong gi srung 'khor bskyed/ oṃ swa bha wa/ sogs sngags gsum brjod pa nas gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya hi sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ sa ma ya mu tra pra bhañja ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpal he ru ka zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe hoḥ byang sgor thal byed ljang khu dril bu dang thod khrag 'dzin pa thams cad kyang / zla ba'i zhal la 'dzum pa'i 'od/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan gos sna tshogs can/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla gdan la/ /dga' bde rol rtsed chags par mdzad/ /ces pa'i bar du lha so so'i bskyed sngags tsam las lha de dang der bskyed la/ lha thams cad kyi gzugs kyi phung po dang mig gi skye mched khams/ zhes pa nas rgyas btab kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de bzhin du sbyar te chu bzhi dang / oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar/ /lha yi dri yis nye bar byugs/ /me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la/ /gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ /puṣ+paṃ༞ oṃ tsan dan gur gum sbyar ba yis/ /dri mchog bdug spos dam pa 'di/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis brlabs nas bzhes su gsol/ /dhup+paṃ༞ oṃ mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba 'di/ /ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed pa/ /lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di/

/bdag la dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /dwi paṃ༞ oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri ldan pa/ /sna tshogs ga bur gyis ni rgyan/ /sna tshogs hūm̐ las yang dag byung / /dri mchog 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /gan+dhaṃ༞ oṃ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs rnams/ /zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /nai wi te༞ de nas mchod pa'i rol mo'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs rnam par dbul bya zhing / /dga' ba'i glu dang dbyangs kyis dbul/ /bkra shis 'don zhing bskor bar bya/ /shap+ta༞ zhes pas nyer spyod/ sgeg sogs brgyad/ 'dod yon rin chen bdun/ yid byung rnams sgrub thabs ltar 'bul/ mchod bstod phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi/ sogs nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ ā hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po༞ rgyal ba rigs lnga༞ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje༞ li tsa bi dri ma med pa༞ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba༞ rgyal bu u pa rā dza༞ grub chen ku ku rā dza༞ mu ti ta nyi zla rdo rje༞ ba dhu ta mu khi༞ dpal sangs rgyas gsang ba༞ paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra༞ rma ā tsar+ya rin chen mchog༞ gye re chos skyong༞ tsu ru rin chen gzhon nu༞ go 'ol tshul khrims 'byung gnas༞ stag rtse 'jam dpal༞ byang chub 'od༞ blo gros rgyal mtshan༞ rong paṇa rin chen tshul khrims༞ rong zom chos kyi bzang po༞ yaṃ shud blo chen༞ mgo zla ba 'bar༞ mgo 'bum grags༞ mgo dngos grub rgyal mtshan༞ mgo dge slong chos rdor༞ mgo dngos grub rgyal mtshan༞ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum༞ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer༞ bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje༞ byang chen pa bsod nams 'phel༞ bag ston gzhon nu tshul༞ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan༞ bla chen bsod nams dpal༞ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' blo gros༞ chos rje nam mkha' tshul khrims༞ rong po blo bzang༞ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje༞ slob dpon saṃ gha shrī༞ slob dpon tshul khrims 'od zer༞

slob dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor༞ 'jam dbyangs rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur sogs dang lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa dang / rigs drug pa'i bar phyi ltar dbul/ bstod pas bstod/ gtor ma phul ba'i mthar/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ thugs rje chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /ma lus sems can don mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras dang bcas/ /stobs mchog rgyal chen rnams la bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rigs bdag che ge'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon gyur las rnams bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsang ba bdag gis bris/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen po/ /gang su lha yi spyan mnga' ba/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming he ru ka zhes pa/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas bri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis mkhyen par gsol/ de nas bum pa bsangs/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bha wā at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan gnyis kyi steng du/ baṃ baṃ las byung ba yi/ /bum pa mgrin ring lto ba zlum/ /nag po dri bral kha khyer can/ /dri zhim tshon dkar gyis byugs shing / /pad+ma'i lte bar mtshan mas brgyan/ /de rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/

lha'i chu dang lnga tshan lngas yongs su gang ba/ oṃ kalpa braṃk+ṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ tod da ka hūm̐/ bum pa lha yi gnas yin te/ /kha rgyan mgul chings rta babs rgyan/ /gzungs thag thugs rje chen po'i rtags/ /sman lnga thugs rje byang chub sems/ /'bru lnga lha yi rang bzhin yin/ /rin chen rnam lnga sku yi 'od/ /snying po ye shes thugs kyi dbyig /spos mchog yon tan tshul khrims rgyan/ /sngags kyi chu dang gnyis med gyur/ /ras gtsang me tog bkram pa'i gzhir/ /shing bzang lo ma 'bras bur bcas/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ /bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing / steng thog rim par phug pa'i nang du/ rigs drug so so'i pho brang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha so so'i gdan dang bcas pa/ gtso bo drug gi gdan gyi steng du/ a ā nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ā lis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga / nas kā lis mtshan pa/ de'i bar du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las kha dog lnga'i 'od 'phros/ snod bcud rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor du byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re/ 'khor rnams kyi gdan gyi steng du hi hī/ dza dzi/ phaṭa phaṭa/ nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnams byung ba'i so so'i phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa sa ma ya pra bhañja ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ he ru'i ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal he ru ka nas/ kha ṭ+wām̐ la brten pa/ rin po ches brgyan pa hūm̐ badz+ra gu h+ya sid+dhi/ shar du gau rī ma dmar ser zhi ba mo/ /zhes pa nas gzhi dkyil gyi byang sgo ma'i bar bskyed/ las thams cad pa'i bum par/ ha las dpal ldan rta mchog rol pa'i sku /sogs yab yum tsam bskyed/ phung khams byin rlabs nas/

rgyas gdab rang rang gi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab pa'i bar bya/ phyi nang gi mchod bstod/ rnam rgyal ma lha so so'i sngags dang / las bum la sum+bha ni thun mong du u ta ka ṭha ci nus bzlas/ slar mchod bstod dang / dung chos kyi chu phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha 'od du zhu bar bsams te/ bum pa sta gon no/ /slob ma sta gon chos bcu bzhi pa ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par mdzod/ slar mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ dngos grub zhu ba/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi sngags rgyas 'debs pa/ slar mchod bstod/ bkra shis par byas te/ nub dang po'i cho ga thams cad bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa sogs lag len ltar byas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar sta gon du bstan pa ltar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hūm̐/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin par gyur/ dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas/ bdag bskyed pa'i bar sta gon bzhin bya/ gdan so so'i steng du bris pa'i mtshan ma rnams lha so so'i sa bon du gyur pa ni/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su hi/ phyogs bzhir hi hī dza dzi/ mtshams bzhir dza dzi phaṭa phaṭa/ lha snam nang ma'i mtshams bzhir ya ra la wa/ phyi ma'i mtshams bzhir a ā aṃ aḥ sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnam snang gi khaṃ/ phyogs bzhir haṃ tshaṃ traṃ dhaṃ/ mtshams bzhir oṃ bh+rūṃ ha khaṃ/ lha snam phyi'i grwa bzhir/ oṃ traṃ baṃ dzaṃ/ a ā aṃ aḥsgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su tri/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du oṃ hrī ho haṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha snam gyi mtshams brgyad du oṃ traṃ baṃ dzaṃ/ a ā am̐ aḥ sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥ 'dab ma brgyad la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ he a hoḥ lha snam gyi mtshams brgyad du oṃ traṃ baṃ dzaṃ/ a ā am̐ aḥ sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su haḥ de'i g.yas su dzi/ g.yon du haḥ 'dab ma brgyad la hi hī dza dzi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ lha snam gyi mtshams brgyad du ya ra la wa/ a ā am̐ aḥ sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐/ de'i phyogs bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: phyogs bzhi'i re re la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ha khaṃ/ lha snam nang ma'i grwa bzhir/ oṃ traṃ baṃ dzaṃ/ de nyid kyi lha snam phyi ma dang gzhi dkyil gyi grwa bzhir a ā aṃ aḥ sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ he ru ka'i dbus su rdo rje/ shar du mda'/ lhor 'khor lo/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du thod pa/ shar lhor rdo rje/ lho nub tu rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mdung / nub byang du ral gri/ byang shar du rdo rje/ lha snam nang ma'i shar lhor mda'/ lho nub tu spos khang / nub byang du sgron me/ byang shar du dri'i dung / shar lhor lcags kyu/ lhor zhags pa/ nub tu lcags sgrog byang du dril bu'o/ /rnam snang gi dbus su chos gos sogs lha so so'i phyag mtshan rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lha so so'i skur gyur pa ni/ oṃ shrī he ru ka zhes pa nas/ dga' bde rol rtsed chags par mdzad/ /ces pa'i bar sta gon bzhin bskyed/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la chu bzhi nyer spyod kyis mchod de dgug gzhug bya/ phung khams bskyed mched byin rlabs nas bzung ste/ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar dang / mchod bstod kyi bar sta gon du bshad pa bzhin bya zhing / sgrub thabs su bstan pa'i cho gas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul lo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma sbyin pa'i tshul ni/

shar du phyogs skyong dang / byang du 'byung po'i gtor ma cha gsum nas bshad pa bzhin 'bul/ nub tu gdan bzhi las gsungs pa'i klu'i gtor ma/ lhor gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /zhes pa nas/ shan+tiṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswāhā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gdan dang mchod yon dbul/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭa hūm̐ bhak+ṣa dzaḥphaṭa/ gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /zhes sogs kyis phrin las gzhol te phyi rol ba'i gtor ma'o/ /de nas kha/ sna/ mig rna ba/ lag mgo lte bar nye reg byas/ rtsa sngags bzlos bzhin pa'i las su yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bskor ba byas te/ be ga kra mas sgo phye/ shar nas/ oṃ pā ra mu kha sha ma su lā li ta/ bi lā s+ya na mi ta/ na mi te/ na ma mi bha ga wan+taṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi pra tits+tsha ku su ma aṃñca liṃ nā tha hoḥ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes me tog 'bul/ pra ti gh+ri/ nas mgo la bcing / phyogs bzhi nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+roṭa gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas sgo dbye/ slar shar sgo nas sgo gsum gyi phyag byas la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi sku drin rgya chen po bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab ste dkyil 'khor chen po grub cing mchod pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bde mchog ma dang mnyam par sbyor/ /bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod/ /sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /zhes dang / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sogs gsum gsum gyis sdom pa gzung / rtsak+ṣu bhan+dha tha ras gdong bcing /

a khaṃ bi ras me tog gtor/ sum bha nis bgegs bskrad/ hūm̐ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bcug 'dod pa dri zhing lan gdab/ sems bskyed/ gsang bar gdams/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta krita hūm̐/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ gis nang du bcug ma hā ra tas bskor ba dang / sgo gsum gyis phyag bya/ phan yon dang nyes dmigs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ prañcā mṛ ta u da ka ṭha hūm̐/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /sogs kyis mna' chu/ bla ma'i bka' nyan pa rnams kyis dam la bzhag ye shes dbab par gsol ba gdab/ sum+bha ni dang / dharma dhā tus sbyangs te rang he ru kar bsam/ rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su dzh+riṃ dmar ljang / sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa'i dbus su nyi ma la a dmar po/ snying gar lam las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar zlum bum pa chus gang bas mtshan pa'i dbus su zla ba la ha dkar po/ bsam pa sogs byas pa/ oṃ dz+nyā na a be sha ya/ stam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ ra la/ tsa lā ya hūm̐ a ha dzhai hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas phab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ me tog gtor cing / gdong phye la/ rang bzhin rnam dag bdag nyid lus/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dri ma med/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i pho brang mchog /dkyil 'khor la ni bus ltos shig /ces pas dkyil 'khor bstan te 'jug pa'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i lam/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo mchog /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de ring dbang bskur gnang ba yi/ /dus la bab pa'i 'os lags pas/ /dpa' bo chen po mi rtog pa'i/ /dbang bskur rim bzhin bdag la stsol/

/zhes gsol ba gdab/ rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du he ru kar skad cig gis bsam la/ til gyis sbyangs/ til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba'i/ /rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni/ /'di nyid du ni blug byas pas/ /bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig /ces dang gtso bo'i sngags kyi mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa'i bkru byab bsrung gsum rgyas par bya zhing bkra shis brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu/ sum+bha ni dang / dharma dhā tus bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje las bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa gnyis ka mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum ma ma ki sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa dgug oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas bum chur gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal/ /de ltar bdag la bstsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lngas byin gyis brlabs/ yum bzhis bum pa thogs te/ til gyi bum pa ltar gang ba'i/ sogs dang / oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya hi sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ sa ma ya mu tra pra bhañja ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes sogs lha thams cad kyi sngags kyi mthar/ badz+ra a bhi ṣ-iñca/ btags pa'i chus dbang bskur ro/ /gtor zhing bkrus pas bag dang dri ma dag

'thungs pas bde bas tshims shing nus pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang / me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs shing / dung dang rnga bo che la sogs pa snyan par sgrog khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du dbang bskur te/ dbang gi lha thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas rang nyid la thim/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ nyer mchod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / bh+rūṃ gyi bdud rtsis mchod/ rtogs pa bskyed pa phyi dang 'dra zhing / rig pa'i dbang thams cad 'dis mtshon te shes par bya'o/ /bdag dang dbang rdzas rin po che'i cod paṇa gnyis ka traṃ dang rin po che las rdo rje nyi ma ser po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na mda' dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang rdo rje nyi ma 'dzin pas yum mā ma ki sngon po rin po che dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ lan gsum byin rlabs sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen las byung dbu rgyan che/ /thor tshugs cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa'i/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra wa ra da ka badz+ra a ra li hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes chus kyang dbang bskur/ sogs gong bzhin la/ rigs bdag so so bya zhing / mchod pa dang rtogs pa bskyed sogs kyang gong bzhin/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje hrī dang pad+ma las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po zhal mang zhing phyag lnga bcu pa g.yas nyer lngas pad+ma rdo rje sogs du ma dang / g.yon pa'i nyer lngas pad+ma'i sdom bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo dkar gsal pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bkra shis skyil krung gis bzhugs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/

sogs/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje gsang ba chen po'i don/ /de ring khyed la dbang bskur te/ /legs par grub phyir rdo rje bzung / /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣ-iñca maṃ/ sogs gong bzhin no/ /bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu ha dang sna tshogs rdo rje las dpal rta mchog rol ba ljang khu dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum rta mgo ljang ba/ phyag brgyad dmar po'i g.yas bzhi ba dan gsum pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon bzhis khu tshur gyis sna tshogs pad+ma/ mdung / dbyug pa/ gzhu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang ser rgya gram dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs nag po bzhis bgegs brgyad mnan pa/ khro rtags drug cu rtsa gcig gis brgyan pa sogs/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kun sogs dang / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dbab/ /sogs/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti staṃ a bhi ṣ-iñca mi/ sogs gong bzhin no/ /paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ khaṃ dang 'khor lo las byung ba'i bdag nyid rnam snang dkar po dkar ser ljang dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis chos gos dang lhung bzed/ 'og ma gnyis 'khar gsil dang glegs bam 'dzin pas yum spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can/ sogs/ oṃ gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin nyid/ /dbang po'i spyod lam gang dang gang / /bde mchog sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ badz+ra nā la a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes sogs gong bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /dbang lnga thob pa'i rgyu las ni/ /ma rig lnga ni rnam spangs te/ /ye shes lnga ni rim gyis yin/ /zhes brjod de/ slob ma'i dbang ngo / /slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang /

mgon po thugs rje'i rang bzhin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor slob dpon dbang bskur sogs/ /bdag gzhan don gyi bya ba rnams/ /sgrub byed dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ /dbang stegs kyi steng du rang nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa bcug la/ dam tshig gsum kyai rdor ltar byin pa'i mthar/ oṃ kā ya wak+tsit+ta ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐/ slar chus dbang bskur nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' dbul ba'i bar byas la/ mtha' rten la bzhi'i/ lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang sgeg sogs brgyad kye rdor bzhin/ gnyis pa phrin las dang dngos grub kyi rjes gnang ni/ bdag gzhan don grub las kyi tshogs/ /thun mong 'bring po las gyur pa/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang / /sdang gnod nges pa'i las kun dang / /dbye rmongs bskrad pa'i cho ga rnams/ /thogs pa med par sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /thogs med mi byin skas 'dzeg cing / /gser 'gyur ril bu nyi zla zung / /char 'bebs la sogs las kyi tshogs/ /rnam shes sgrub dang ye shes sgrub/ /phyag rgya zhes pa'i dngos grub dang / /thams cad sgrub cing grol ba yi/ /don gnyis yang dag grol bar gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gnas 'jug cing / /sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan rgyas/ /phrin las gzhan dag sbyor ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dngos grub gnang / /zhes brjod/ gsum pa 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang mig thur/ me long / dril bu/ me long gnyis pa/ mda' gzhu rnams kye rdor ltar byin/ bzhi pa chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ 'khor lo/ dung / dril bu/ po ti rnams spyi ltar byin la/ oṃ pha rol phyin drug las rnams kyis/ /sems can kun don rab sbyor zhing / /'khor ba'i rgyun gcod mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor/ /the tshom rtog tshogs gcod mdzad pa'i/

/chos kyi dung ni rab sgrogs shing / /gsang sngags snying po'i gsang chen 'di/ /snod ldan kun la rab tu shod/ /de ni rgyal bas thams cad la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /khyed la rtag tu srung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod bye brag rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba spyi ltar sbyin/ gnyis pa dbugs dbyung ba ni/ 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /rdo rje dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /dngos grub mchog tu sgrub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las grol/ /kyai che ge mo ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur+bhu wa swa/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /dus gcig tu ni lung bstan pas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gsang sngags mthus/ /skad cig dus kyi lung bstan mdzad/ /ces brjod/ gsum pa dbugs dbyung ba ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /nas/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /nas/ sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /bzhis gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs shing mthong ba la sogs pas/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /khyed rnams rab tu bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yongs med cing / /mtshungs med thub par mi 'gyur ba/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das pa'o/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni yongs mi spang / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pas/ /dam pa'i chos ni mi smad cing / /ma gus pa dang dor mi bya/ /mi shes snod min rmongs pa dang / /nam yang bstan par mi bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang zhing / /slob dpon la ni rtag gus bya/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid la/ /bdag por rgyal chen dbang bskur zhing / /bdud rnams thams cad las rgyal bas/

/grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /'di yis khyed rnams dus kun tu/ /sangs rgyas thob par the tshom med/ /zhes brjod/ rtogs pa skyed pa spyi dang 'dra ste bum pa'i dbang ngo / /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal/ dpal ldan mgon po bde ba che/ /bde chen bde ba'i gnas la zhugs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde gsol mdzod/ /rdo rje dri med bdud rtsi'i mchog /ma rig rtog pa'i rab rib gsol/ /gang gi byang chub bla med pas/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /gsang rdzas bsgrub pa spyi ltar la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /rang gi sras mchog dbang bskur zhing / /byang chub sems te dag pa'i chus/ /rtog tshogs dri ma dag par byed/ /oṃ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes pas gsang dbang dang / kye ma mgon po bde ba che/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /phyag rgya mi phyed rab sgrub pa/ /mngon sum nyams myong bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bdag nyid chen po ji lta bar/ /gtso bos bdag la mdzad du gsol/ /rtog pa'i dri mas sgrib pa rnams/ /byang chub chu yis dag par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba gdab/ dga' ba'i gnas chen lha mo 'di/ /sna tshogs sgyu rtsal yid du 'ong / /legs par zung zhig blo gros mchog /dga' bde'i mchod pa rab tu gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad 'gyur/ /de bas khyod kyis bdag nyid dang / /nam yang 'bral bar mi bya ste/ /'di rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang gis 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces pas rig ma gtad/ /des dri ba bya ba ni/ dri chen dri chu bza' btung dang / /rak+ta ga bur maṃ sa dang / /bud med rnams la dad gus shing / /bha gar tsum+bha mi rtog pa/ /smros shig grogs po bde ba can/ /zhes dri ba'i lan du/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/

/khu khrag la sogs za ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag gus shing / /dga' bas pad+mar 'o bgyid do/ /zhes lan btab pas mnyes te/ rmad byung gsang ba'i pad+ma 'di/ /thams cad bde ba yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu rin chen 'di spyod na/ /de nyid bde chen 'bral mi 'gyur/ /chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can thams cad rnam par grol/ /dngos po kun gyi rang byung gnas/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma la zhugs rab tu rgyas/ /bha ga mkha' dbyings nam mkha' bzhin/ /'byung ba lnga pos brgyan zhing bkod/ /lte ba ze'u 'bru ge sar zlum/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad rnam par mdzes/ /de yi dbus su gnas pa ni/ /de nyid bdud rtsi bde chen gzugs/ /bhañca mok+ṣa ho/ 'du shes gsum gyi dga' ba bzhi lugs 'byung lugs bzlog tu bskyed pa'i mthar/ lha mo des phyag g.yon rang gi mgo bor bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar/ /sems can kun la rmi lam ltar/ /kun gyis dngos pos don gyis shig /ces gnang ba byin pa dbang gsum pa dang / khyed zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /sogs dang / phyi dang nang du legs spyod pa/ /phyi dang nang gi rang bzhin te/ /rang bzhin chos ni thams cad la/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes brjod/ /snang ba med cing ming gsal ba/ /skye ba med cing gnas med pa/ /lnga yis de nyid rdzogs pa ste/ /rim gyis lhan skyes zad pa med/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' med pa/ /'gro ba brtan dang g.yo bdag nyid/ /bdag med pa ru bdag med gnas/ /zhes pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag slar/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /rdo rje bla ma byang chub sems/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtang zhing / /dran pa gsal bas bzung byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha bzhin rin chen rtogs/ /zhes pa gsungs par bsam ste dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de lta bu'i dbang re re la maṇ+ḍal dbul ba/ mig dar bcing dgrol/
